newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian metalworkers complete talks with Prodi.
newsitem.headline: Italian metalworkers complete talks with Prodi.

text.p: Italian engineering and metalworker union leaders finished a meeting with prime minister Romano Prodi on Thursday on their bitter dispute over wage contracts without making any comment on the outcome.

The leaders of Italy's three main unions CGIL, CISL and UIL attended the meeting, which also included Labour minister Tiziano Treu, finance minister Vincenzo Visco and industry minister Pier Luigi Bersani.
Talks on wage contract renewals will continue this afternoon as Treu meets with the FIOM, FIM and UILM unions, and then with representatives of the employers association Federmeccanica.
The union-employer contracts expired in June and unions have recently held national strikes in support of their claims for wage rises for the 1997-98 contractual period.
